summary: TSM-001 represents signed intermediate-horizon own-trend state behavior.
MI-001 and HV-001 supported the own-trend direction mechanism.
CV-001 showed reproducibility and coherence, limited by current-constituent data.
PV-001 found zero supported horizons for future return prediction.
PV-001 supported future realized volatility information at 21d, 63d and 126d.

No production deployment validation was performed.
